name: 0xb55fa1296E6ec55D0cE5
headline: Churns about $8M a month through crypto Up/Down windows. Its trading loses money after fees; the profit is the Diamond-tier taker rebate plus a one-off $25,000 level-up bonus. Without the bonus the last 30 days made $31,101, and a newcomer at the 0% tier would lose about $40.3k a month.
mechanism: About 467k fills in 30 days across BTC/ETH/SOL 5m, 15m, hourly and 4h windows; 30% maker fills on-chain. Settled market PnL -$48,609 after fees (locked pair spread -$90,221, residual $41,612). Taker fees $157,292; the taker rebate runs at 44% of the previous day's fees (Diamond), and on 2026-10-25 it paid an extra $25,264, the one-time bonus for first reaching Obsidian.

monthly_50k.detail: passes the A1 rule as written (last 30 days $56,365, median block $78,075), but $25,264 of the last 30 days is a one-time level-up bonus: recurring 30-day PnL $31,101 < $50k

roc.detail: 87%/month: 30-day PnL $56,365 on peak capital at risk $64,873; counting the on-chain collateral too ($126,320), at least 29%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 30% maker fills (95% CI 24%-37%), 21% of USDC

match.detail: BTC 5m latency taker: stratified AUC 0.498 vs rotation null 0.505 (max 0.565), p=0.61; rule flags 24% of the wallet's decisions at 1.1x the base rate; BTC 5m directional maker: stratified AUC 0.481 vs rotation null 0.502 (max 0.559), p=0.80; rule flags 31% of the wallet's decisions at 1.1x the base rate; BTC 5m spot-reactive maker: stratified AUC 0.466 vs rotation null 0.501 (max 0.555), p=0.86; rule flags 11% of the wallet's decisions at 0.7x the base rate; BTC 15m directional maker (its largest family): stratified AUC 0.573 vs rotation null 0.496 (max 0.605), p=0.04; rule flags 12% of the wallet's decisions at 0.6x the base rate

backtest.detail: latency taker -0.6% (72,714 trades, p(profit)=0.55); 5m directional maker (strict) -13.5% (5,973 fills, p(profit)=1.00); 15m directional maker (strict) -18.8% (3,057 fills, p(profit)=0.99); reviewer tape-anchored two-sided maker -6% to -13%, late-favourite taker not significant once tail risk is tested; its own trading after fees -$48,609 in 30 days

replicable.detail: observed taker-rebate tier Diamond (44% of fees); 30-day PnL at the 0% tier -$40,301, Gold -$11,988, Diamond $28,908, Obsidian $38,346; Diamond needs $4M of 30-day weighted volume, which a newcomer reaches in about 23 days at the same volume, and the pre-fee edge per dollar has fallen from 2.6% to 1.3% over six months

persistence.detail: last 30 days not significant (p=0.089); significant decline vs. earlier days (p=0.009). [recurring series (one-off bonus removed): last 30 days p=0.089; decline vs earlier p=0.009; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.53; trend p=0.39] Also: pre-fee trading PnL declined significantly (p=6e-6).

reasons: Its trading loses money; the profit is Polymarket's taker rebate.
Recurring monthly profit is below $50k once a one-time level-up bonus is removed.
On that recurring series the last 30 days are not significant and the decline is significant.
A replicator without the top tiers would lose money; no public-data rule matches its decisions.
corrections: The rebate tier is Diamond (44%), not Obsidian ('61% of fees' came from the one-off $25,264 level-up bonus on 2026-10-25).
The persistence pass depended on that bonus; without it the recent window is not significant and the decline is.
'Taker fees' were listed as if separate from settled PnL; settled PnL is already after fees.
